newsitem.title: USA: Group sells stake in Saga Communications.
newsitem.headline: Group sells stake in Saga Communications.

text.p: A Boston investment group that includes limited partnerships HLM Partners II, IV and VI said on Monday that it sold its entire stake of Saga Communications Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 300,000 class A common shares of Saga between Sept. 12, 1994 and May 22, 1995 for a total of $4.99 million.
The filing did not say when its shares were sold or for how much, but said the sales were made as a result of an investment decision.
